reproducibility_caveat: This resolve was performed against live package indexes on 2026-10-02. narwhals arrived at 2.26.0. A future re-resolve could select a different narwhals. Since narwhals is off the C4 path and absent from the authoritative court, that would not affect the qualification result — but it would change the freeze hash. The 13-package historical subset is index-independent because every one of those is exactly pinned.
